contentText: Switzerland has announced that talks planned between the US and Iran - are postponed. Iran's supreme leader voiced scepticism over the deal after it was signed and US Vice President JD Vance cancelled his trip to Geneva. Meanwhile, in Lebanon, fighting continued between the Israeli army and Hezbollah. Lebanon reported that 16 were killed on the morning of June 19, Hezbollah hit Israeli troops - killing 4 soldiers.
